cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

mechanism: A grants the helper apparent choices while warmly reallocating both choice and division of work to A preferred arrangement.
confusable: A plain order lacks D69 if it does not appreciatively narrow an initially available alternative.
comparison: Packing fragile objects alone differs from canceling a venue backup and spending the refund.
seedUse: Use D69-b carefulness as rationale for unwanted plates and B proposed wrapping division as next narrowed choice; remove cold stock command.
